oxidation.source: oxo_two_marker delta_beta (paired G->T - C->A, B1 SE gate)

verdict.note: Canonical per-axis calls; each `source` points to the authoritative readout. deamination = age-bearing terminal C->T (the only ancient-vs-modern discriminator). damaged_fraction = pi (deamination-defined strata). oxidation = oxo_two_marker G->T, REAL but NOT ancient-specific (also from sample prep). preservation = aggregate index.

deamination.per_damaged_A_b_note: upper bound unidentified reference-free (= amp/pi_dmg, pi_dmg unknown)

mixture.conditions: GC-partitioned mixture; valid only when damaged and non-damaged GC distributions separable

by_length_joint.conditions: length x damage joint mixture; identifies damaged fraction from fragment-length prior

oxo_two_marker.interpretation: Interior-Chargaff D regressed on ssDNA-overhang markers; recovers modest interior oxidation (G to T strong, C to A weak) that the terminal-scope channels C/D/F miss. C/D/F are scope-limited detectors whose nulls are informative, not the primary oxidation verdict.

damage_channel_stats.deam_strata_note: circular_diagnostic: strata keyed and read on the same 3' terminus; gradient is partly tautological. Use decirc for the de-circularized, gated readout.

strata_summary.note: Pooled terminal-vs-interior rate per process within each deam stratum (0=non-damaged..4=most-damaged). FULL per-stratum info; contrasts left to the consumer. Per-read deam binning is a weak cross-end proxy, NOT a clean ancient/modern split.

damage_context.interpretation: terminal C->T / G->A enrichment consistent with post-mortem cytosine deamination

bulk_damage.lambda_interpretation: exponential positional decay of terminal damage/overhang signal; not a direct fragment-length or strand-break rate
bulk_damage.conditions: requires high-coverage near-saturated libraries; not valid for low-damage or mixed libraries

tau_discriminator.note: tau = overhang e-fold (bp); f0 = pervasive floor; overhang_fraction = A/(A+f0) boundary-robust gate

scission.note: gamma bp^-1 = exp(-gamma*(L-L_mode)) right-tail MLE; larger gamma -> shorter, more degraded DNA

oxidation_epsilon.note: ASYMMETRIC leakage control: epsilon=T/(T+G)-A/(A+C) cancels symmetric oxidation by construction; epsilon~0 expected for 8-oxoG; |epsilon_term|>>0 flags C->T contamination

gc_depletion.note: GC-depletion channel: sigma0=T/(T+G)+A/(A+C)-1 is composition+deamination+oxidation combined — NOT an oxidation estimator. Oxidation readout is oxo_two_marker. Residualize against gc_interior for cross-sample GC-normalisation.

burial_fingerprint.note: theta=ln(gamma/f0) hydrolytic fragmentation pressure index: scission/deamination rate ratio. Sensitive to pH but also temperature, water activity, and deamination saturation. NOT a pH meter. phi_share=sigma0/(sigma0+f0) upper bound on oxidation fraction

damage_types.name: cytosine_deamination
damage_types.description: C to T post-mortem deamination at terminal positions

damage_types.name: stop_codon_conversion
damage_types.description: CAA/CAG/CGA to TAA/TAG/TGA via C to T; reference-free damage validator

damage_types.name: 8_oxog_top_strand
damage_types.description: G to T oxidative stop codons (GAA/GAG/GGA); top-strand 8-oxoguanine. Scope: top-strand G to T stop codons only; an informative null does not exclude interior oxidation (see oxo_two_marker), and the channel is diluted by non-damaged-read admixture.

damage_types.name: chargaff_gt_asymmetry
damage_types.description: Strand-asymmetric G to T / C to A excess; reference-free 8-oxoG cross-check. SS-only: for DS libraries D cancels by Chargaff second-parity (an expected null, not absence of oxidation). The marker-regressed primary form is oxo_two_marker.

damage_types.name: purine_enrichment
damage_types.description: A+G enrichment over all bases at read starts; reference-free AP-site/depurination proxy

damage_types.name: 8_oxog_complement
damage_types.description: C to A oxidative stop codons (TCA/TCG/TAC/TGC); bottom-strand 8-oxoguanine. Scope: terminal stop-enrichment proxy for an established lesion -- a null means no TERMINAL oxidation enrichment and is insensitive to interior/non-terminal oxidation (the primary reference-free oxidation readout is oxo_two_marker)

damage_types.name: cg_stop_enrichment
damage_types.description: C to G stop codons (TCA/TAC to TGA/TAG); empirical terminal stop-enrichment. NOT an earned hydantoin assignment (hydantoins are guanine over-oxidation products; this is a complement-strand C to G observation)

damage_types.name: at_stop_enrichment
damage_types.description: A to T stop codons (AAA/AAG/AGA to TAA/TAG/TGA); empirical terminal stop-enrichment. No established direct adenine-oxidation to A to T pathway

damage_types.name: 8_oxog_complement_3prime
damage_types.description: C to A oxidative stop rate at the 3' end (rate-only; no terminal-enrichment z/OR inference)

damage_types.name: cg_stop_enrichment_3prime
damage_types.description: C to G stop rate at the 3' end (rate-only; empirical, no z/OR inference)

damage_types.name: at_stop_enrichment_3prime
damage_types.description: A to T stop rate at the 3' end (rate-only; empirical, no z/OR inference)
